title: Unity Catalog model load/register artifacts: route both through the Databricks Files API behind MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC, switched together
answers: UC model load or register fails with a vended-token or scoped-credential error on DBR 15.4 LTS
How do I make Unity Catalog model downloads and uploads go through the Files API instead of scoped cloud credentials?
Where is the artifact repository chosen when registering a model version to Unity Catalog?
Why does downloading a UC model file use a single stream instead of presigned multipart download?
body:
Path: Unity Catalog model-registry artifact transfer for `models:/catalog.schema.model/version` on `databricks-uc`. Two entry points pick the artifact repo: the load path `UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository._get_artifact_repo` (mlflow/store/artifact/unity_catalog_models_artifact_repo.py) and the register path `UcModelRegistryStore._get_artifact_repo` (mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py), called from `create_model_version`.
Rule: When `MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC` is true (`mlflow/environment_variables.py`, default False, read at call time), both entry points return `DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository`, which moves files via `WorkspaceClient().files` under `/Models/<catalog>/<schema>/<model>/<version>`. With it false, they keep the scoped-cloud-credential repo. Change routing in both places together, never one. `CloudArtifactRepository._download_file` must download in one stream for this class (matched by class name), because presigned URIs do not apply to it. `is_fuse_or_uc_volumes_uri` in `mlflow/utils/uri.py` treats `/Models/` paths as UC paths.
Symptom: Unity Catalog blocks vended tokens, so load and register through scoped credentials stopped working on DBR 15.4 LTS; the Files API path is the replacement.
Constraints: Flag off keeps the previous scoped-credential behaviour exactly. Applies only to UC model registry paths, not to Volumes, DBFS or non-UC registries.
applies: UC model-registry load and register artifact routing, and the env flag that selects it.

history.prevBody:
Path: Unity Catalog model-registry artifact I/O, covering model load (`models:/<catalog>.<schema>.<model>/<version>` downloads) and model register (create_model_version uploads) against the `databricks-uc` registry. Both pass through `mlflow/store/artifact/unity_catalog_models_artifact_repo.py:UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository._get_artifact_repo` (load) and `mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py:UcModelRegistryStore._get_artifact_repo` (register).
Rule: Each `_get_artifact_repo` checks `mlflow/environment_variables.py:MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC` first (read at call time, default False). When true it returns `mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository` and skips the scoped-token and presigned-URL setup entirely. When false, behavior is unchanged. Any new UC model artifact path should add its gate at the same top-of-method point so both directions stay in sync.
Constraints: Applies only to Unity Catalog models (`databricks-uc`), not to UC Volumes or classic model registry. The flag is opt-in and must be set in the environment before the call. Gate is read per call, so changing it mid-process takes effect on the next artifact operation.

says: Loading or registering a model version in the catalog fails with token credential errors.
Model artifact downloads fail on newer workspace runtimes because cloud tokens are blocked.
Route catalog model uploads and downloads through the workspace files service instead.
Saving a new registered model version errors out when using scoped cloud credentials.
Support single stream model downloads when presigned cloud links are blocked.
search: When MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC is enabled in mlflow/environment_variables.py, Unity Catalog model artifact transfer routes both load and register paths to DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository via WorkspaceClient().files under /Models/<catalog>/<schema>/<model>/<version>. This routing must be switched together in UcModelRegistryStore._get_artifact_repo (in mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py) and UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository._get_artifact_repo (in mlflow/store/artifact/unity_catalog_models_artifact_repo.py). CloudArtifactRepository._download_file forces single-stream downloads for this repository class because presigned URIs do not apply, and is_fuse_or_uc_volumes_uri treats /Models/ as UC paths. This replaces scoped-credential transfers that fail with vended-token errors on DBR 15.4 LTS, and applies strictly to UC model registry paths rather than Volumes, DBFS, or non-UC registries.
